quote: Restoring access to the waterfront for nearby communities, many of which have been cut off by highway and rail infrastructure, would allow for improved access to UWF's campus and create new opportunities for research, education, and recreation. This multimodal corridor would directly link students, faculty, and residents to both our main campus and our holdings in downtown Pensacola, helping to reduce transportation barriers and support disadvantaged communities.
author: Martha Saunders
title: President
